purpose: Groups related content into collapsible disclosure sections.
useWhen: Users should reveal sections on demand.
A disclosure group needs single or multiple expanded sections.

avoidWhen.situation: All content must remain visible for comparison.
avoidWhen.guidance: Render visible sections instead of hiding content in disclosures.

approvedPatterns: Use the items API for uniform sections.
Compose item, header, and panel parts for custom markup.
Use the skeleton mode while section content loads.
limitations: Skeleton mode is a placeholder and does not expose disclosure controls.
accessibility: Disabled and expanded states are provided by React Aria.
Skeleton output is marked busy and labeled.
responsive: The root and triggers fill their container.
rtl: Use right indicator alignment when the design calls for a leading-side indicator.
